rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, before 2001).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 2001 as 'Harper Adams'.
rows.Bloom: Golden-yellow. Moderate fragrance. Medium to large, double (17-25 petals), in small clusters bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Named to mark the centenary of Harper Adams University College.
